title: If you’re not quite sure where the journey is taking you
summary: How two apprentices at Mercer Rosenthal found their path – and became among the best in their class For many young people, the end of...
body_markdown:
### The beginning of a journey


The stories of Nils Koburger and Florian Krauß show that no one starts their career with absolute certainty. But with curiosity, dedication and the right support, uncertainty can turn into confidence.


Sometimes, that journey even leads to becoming one of the best in the class.


And that is exactly what Mercer Rosenthal aims to provide: a place where young people can grow, take responsibility and shape their future.


Want to write your own chapter at Mercer? Check out our open apprenticeship positions for 2026/2027[here](https://sites.google.com/mercerint.com/ausbildungbeimercerrosenthal/startseite) and apply for an internship!


To learn more about our apprenticeship programs, check out our[YouTube channel!](https://youtube.com/@mercer_int?si=J9aZOgu251OTKL8U)
